notes.title: Demo updated to version 3.0
notes.content:
We added in new version
- 2 new maps
- 2 new types of monsters
- one of monster types function as a group
- lockpick mechanic
- 10+ new secrets
- several new ingredients 
- 2 new potions

notes.title: Level2 released for Demo version
notes.content:
[list]
[*] level 2 is available now !
[*] + 2 new enemies
[*] + 2 new potions with recipes
[*] + 3 secret locations

[*] performance is optimized
[/list]

notes.title: Planned enhancements released
notes.content:
1. Tooltip fixes. Tooltip fonts now are bigger and readable. Tooltip spawn is twice faster that in previous builds.
2. Potion Craft tutorial page fonts are more readable
3. Killed monster can be looted clicking at their bodies
4. Improved working of Splash Area projectiles
5. Craft pot redesigned
